title: Tsubasa: Spring Thunder Chronicles
synopsis:
Tsubasa/xxxHOLiC Project

A 4 part OVA released with the limited editions of the Tsubasa and xxxHOLiC volumes.

There are two OVAs for each series, with plots linked together.

They cover the Nihon Country Arc and scarcely some of the Celes Country Arc.

(Source: Official Project Website)

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.synopsis: Following the battle with King Ashura, Fey's weakened powers lead Kurogane to make a stunning sacrifice. After the group arrives in the his homeland, Kurogane must face a foe with a very familiar face.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.synopsis: Syaoran once more faces Syaoran, and Sakura is wounded during the battle.  Yet, once more, things are not what they seem - Syaoran is not the only traveler who seems to have a clone!
